fato_historico: 2011: Libyan Crisis: Rebel forces capture Libyan dictator Muammar Gaddafi and his son Mutassim in his hometown of Sirte and kill them shortly thereafter, ending the first Libyan civil war.
energia_do_dia: Today carries a powerful vibration of shedding old skins and welcoming newfound liberation. Much like the tides of history turn to clear the path for a brighter horizon, you may feel an urge to release outdated patterns. It is a good time to embrace change, allowing your inquisitive Gemini spirit to find clarity in the stillness.
frase_do_dia: Let go of the heavy past to fully bloom in the light of today.
significado_numero: Represents the closing of cycles and the beginning of peaceful new chapters.
conselho: Consider decluttering your space to invite fresh, positive energy into your daily life.
